A '''gauntlet''' was a heavy-duty [[Glove/Legends|glove]] that extended past the [[Limb/Legends|wrist]] and was used in different types of [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Gauntlets were frequently used as weapons&mdash;to increase the wielder's unarmed combat ability&mdash;or to conceal weapons. In a few cases, gauntlets held specific heavy weapons or had other utilities (medical, demolitions).
